claim_boundary: Literature/corpus synthesis only. No claim for or against RH.

target.I1: Noncompact scale space with a dilation action.
target.I2: All-place multiplicative arithmetic action with primitive prime and repeated prime-power orbit lengths, but no independent mixed composite orbit.
target.I3: Canonical Hilbert space and inner product.
target.I4: A self-adjoint generator whose spectrum itself is the zeta zero ordinates.
target.I5: The archimedean Gamma, pi and Gaussian/Fourier place on the same state space.

map_gaps.classification_note: Zero-attempt is map metadata, not absence from the corpus or literature.
map_gaps.b_explanation: These are zero-attempt map components, not newly discovered finished frameworks. Together they reduce to the already-recorded stochastic-scale-semigroup-on-connes-cokernel or an equivalent all-place Deninger/Arakelov realization. The Ising/Lee-Yang compiler stays in (a) because it reduces to a criterion and does not supply I4.
map_gaps.g2: No escape: Lee-Yang, Li, Jensen, Newman and screw positivity are criteria; de Branges positivity is too strong; Hankel/archimedean dominance do not supply I2 and I4.
map_gaps.g5: TFPT bridge paths terminate at the explicit formula or finite Weil windows; cm-seam, mu4-mark, seam-geodesic, tfpt-c3 and tfpt-gcar have no live path.
map_gaps.g6: Live closers are W3/W4/L*, the all-place intersection and the already-named stochastic Connes cokernel.

corpus_contact.warning: Focused counts are case-insensitive file/line counts over the requested corpus surfaces; broad family labels and generic arithmetic uses are excluded where possible.

frameworks.obstruction: The unrenormalized explicit formula has an archimedean continuous term; Kurasov-Sarnak say Guinand's zeta example is not their Fourier quasicrystal even under RH. Finite-variable Lee-Yang constructions cannot carry the infinite Q-rank module generated by log primes.
frameworks.qualification: A renormalized tempered-distribution criterion is a restatement, not a positivity mechanism.

frameworks.obstruction: Connected sectors create mixed closed walks of length log(pq). Decoupling follows only with Q-independent lengths, exact prime-power support and no cancellation; cancellation-engineered butterfly swarms exist but do not yield one canonical full zeta generator.
frameworks.qualification: NO-GO for connected noncancelling metric graphs; NEUTRAL/OPEN for infinite cancellation-engineered swarms.

frameworks.obstruction: Its H3 L-function is L(f8), so GRH for that modular L-function is separate from RH for zeta.
frameworks.qualification: RH-neutral arithmetic realization of the TFPT f8 cusp channel.

frameworks.obstruction: Prime-knot and linking-residue correspondences are analogies without the required analytic state space and generator.
Trace/determinant theorems hold for actual foliated systems; the arithmetic foliation and polarization remain conjectural.
frameworks.qualification: UNEXAMINED-WORTH-A-CONTRACT only for the already-known arithmetic realization.

frameworks.obstruction: Known manifolds have geometric primitive length spectra and different archimedean/topological factors. No general published theorem excluding every hypothetical log-prime length spectrum was found.
frameworks.qualification: NO-GO for known manifolds; OPEN only as Deninger's conjectural arithmetic flow.

frameworks.obstruction: The K3 lattice 3U plus 2E8(-1) and Hodge index do not supply an arithmetic scale action.
Rosati positivity proves a local finite-field RH mechanism; independent per-place positivity is globally blind.
Mobius inversion is Euler-product inversion; PSL2/metaplectic scale geometry reduces to Tate, Berry-Keating and Connes; a Mobius strip adds no arithmetic action.
Finite self-adjoint approximants exist; convergence to a generator carrying all zeros is open.
For fixed D the inverse problem is equivalent to zero-freeness on Re(s)=D, hence the all-D statement is exactly RH.
The scaling site already realizes the tropical all-place language, but not the global zero generator.
No accepted direct zeta/RH arithmetic mechanism was found.
frameworks.qualification: Unexamined but shape-irrelevant, so no contract.

frozen_contract: Use an adelic or Arakelov quotient with self-dual Haar measure.
Construct a conservative Markov scale semigroup P_t with t=log r.
Derive primitive components p and repetitions p^k with no mixed primitive orbit.
Realize s<->1-s as OS reflection including the real place.
Define a canonical self-adjoint generator independently of zeta continuation.
Prove a trace or resolvent identity identifying its spectrum with zero ordinates.
synthesis: No new shape-relevant geometry survives. Quasicrystals and fractal strings are restatements; f8 Calabi-Yau, K3/Rosati and Mobius routes are neutral or covered; ordinary quantum graphs and known hyperbolic manifolds miss the required prime-only all-place orbit structure. The sole contract remains the already-recorded adelic stochastic scale semigroup, equivalently an arithmetic Deninger/Arakelov realization.
